claims.claim: Engine, suspension and body parts for all model of Acura and Honda cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Witness only reported a single grey Honda Accord interior trim/panel piece; no engine/suspension/body parts or “all models” coverage shown.

risks.risk: Wrong exact part/variant for the buyer’s specific Honda Accord (year/model/trim) even if it looks similar
risks.proof: A clear close-up showing the exact part number/label on the piece (or the back side markings) plus a photo of the mounting side that matches the buyer’s car
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used interior trim piece with compatibility uncertainty (assume may not fit).

risks.risk: Damage not visible in the reported shot (cracks, hairline breaks, warping) or missing clips/fasteners
risks.proof: Photos of the entire piece from multiple angles (front/back/edges) showing all mounting holes and any clip points, plus a close-up of edges for cracks
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/with missing fasteners (assume needs replacement clips or may not mount securely).

risks.risk: Surface wear (scratches, fading, stains, prior repairs) affecting appearance value
risks.proof: Bright-light close-ups of the visible surfaces and corners/edges to show scratches, discoloration, and any repair marks

risks.risk: Mounting points may be misaligned or incomplete (some holes/slots may not line up)
risks.proof: A photo that shows all mounting holes/slots in one frame, and a measurement/fit-check video against the intended mounting area (if possible)
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to align perfectly.

risks.risk: Left/right or side-specific fitment (or need for brackets) not confirmed
risks.proof: A photo showing any side-specific features (shape differences, tabs) and confirmation of which side it belongs to

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any part number/label or markings on the panel (front and back).
Send full photos of the entire piece showing all edges, mounting holes, and clip points (front/back).
Show whether any clips/fasteners are included or missing (photo of the back/attachment points).
Confirm the exact Honda Accord year/trim the part came from, and whether it’s left/right specific.
If possible, provide a quick fit-check video against the car’s mounting area.
response.reason: The witness clearly identified the item as a Honda Accord interior trim/panel piece, so it can be priced as a used interior part at worst-case compatibility and condition. Seller’s broad claims about engines/suspension and all models are not supported by the reported evidence.
